description: Declare the failures Forgejo's repository list endpoints produce in practice but the Swagger document leaves out. Hooks, Actions secrets and Actions variables answer 403 for a credential that cannot administer the repository, and the branch-protection list — the one repository list declared with no failure at all — answers 404 for a missing repository and 403 for one the token cannot read, exactly as its sibling single-rule endpoints declare. Undeclared, these surface as out-of-union Forbidden/NotFound errors that a caller sweeping every accessible repository cannot skip without loosening types.
